title: SAVA A7L Pro ride review after500km
notes: Named reviewer Mike Dee describes a self-purchased A7L Pro with105R7120,50mm carbon wheels and25C tires after500km. Reports a responsive feel under power and firm ride compared with a Trek Domane with IsoSpeed. Site discloses affiliate links; purchase and mileage are author reports, not independently verified. Qualitative whole-bike ride evidence, not a numeric isolated-frame test. Worker and parent read relevant passages. No maximum clearance inferred.
